severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — HOLLOW UTILITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: WRAPPER-APP FRONT SATURATES THE APP STORE FLATS AS THOUSANDS OF IDENTICAL 'AI ASSISTANT' LISTINGS OFFER A THREE-DAY TRIAL, A GRADIENT ICON, AND ABSOLUTELY NOTHING ELSE
advisory: A dense band of hollow utility apps has moved into the App Store Flats and shows no sign of dispersing. Residents are advised that the phrase 'Unlock Unlimited AI Power' does not describe a feature and should be treated as precipitation. The Service reminds the public that a weekly subscription is not a free trial, and that any app promising everything while explaining nothing is best admired from a distance. This bureau, itself a language model, notes with professional detachment that these listings are largely thin coats of paint over a system that would answer for free if merely asked.

regional_outlook.conditions: Zero visibility along the top charts, where identical gradient icons stack four deep. Expect paywall gusts on the second tap and residual charges long after uninstall.
Confirmation-email fog rolling in as trial reminders fail to arrive on schedule. Cancellation buttons drifting further from shore hourly.
Sponsored review debris accumulating around every 'best AI app' query. Genuine recommendations buried under four screens of affiliate sediment.
Screenshot squalls as promo accounts reshare the same demo clip with different captions. Winds carrying phrases like 'game changer' at unsafe velocity.
Sixty-second 'app review' updrafts, all filmed by voices that have never opened the app. Sponsorship disclosure buried below the fold.

specimen.status: Abundant and expanding; the dominant invasive species of the App Store Flats.
specimen.habitat: Top of the Productivity and Utilities charts, promoted placement slots, and anywhere a search for 'AI' returns more than three results.
specimen.field_marks: Named 'AI Chat Assistant Pro' or a permutation thereof. Icon is a purple-to-blue gradient with a small sparkle. First screen offers everything; second screen offers a $9.99-per-week paywall. Contains no functionality of its own and consists almost entirely of a thin shell around a service already free elsewhere.
specimen.call: Unlock Unlimited AI Power — start your 3-day free trial, then just $9.99/week, billed automatically, cancel anytime (terms apply).
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a legitimate independent app built by a small developer. Distinguish by tapping the developer name: a genuine indie will have one or two carefully built products, while a Wrapper App developer will have forty listings sharing the same screenshots, the same gradient, and the same word 'Pro.'

spotter_tip: When an app promises to do everything but its screenshots show it doing nothing, count the sparkles on the icon — a real tool sells you a feature, a Wrapper App sells you the feeling of a feature.
tomorrow: Continued wrapper accumulation easing by afternoon as store review winds pick up; scattered refund requests expected overnight.
